name: slow
description: Manual slow mode for Codex: pause between steps so tokens burn slower and you get room to think.

interface.shortDescription: Pause Codex between steps on purpose
interface.longDescription: Slow adds a configurable pause before every tool call and every user prompt. Turn it on when you want a session to burn tokens more slowly, keep more room to think between steps, or simply step away without the work racing ahead. Default delay is 5 seconds; the setting lives in a small text file you can edit by hand.
defaultPrompt: Slow down: pause 5s before each step
